businessGoal: To allow users to filter items by category for easier navigation and retrieval.

scenarios.goal: User can successfully apply a filter to view items from a selected category.
User receives an appropriate message when trying to filter with a non-existent category.
User can reset the filter and view all items.

clarifications: There are no details on how multiple categories can be selected or if that functionality exists.
The impact of clearing filters on the state of the displayed items is not mentioned.

manual.reason: The acceptance criteria describe user interaction with filtering functionality.

api.reason: The business behavior of filtering by category can likely be validated through the API.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria includes visible user interactions with filtering in the UI.
